title: spellbook
summary: Benilla defines SMSG_INITIAL_SPELLS (book + cooldown list), SMSG_LEARNED_SPELL, SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL, and the five server-side cooldown packets. MSUI implements the book trio field-exactly (PlayerActions.ApplyInitialSpells incl. the cooldown list and the permanent-cooldown spell_cd_ms==1 skip, Learn/Supercede) plus SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN with correct self/pet addressing and the cooldown_ms==0 use-Spell.dbc fork, but the other four cooldown packets have no handler.

openItems.text: SMSG_ITEM_COOLDOWN unhandled - the proc-triggered 30 s equipped-item use-cooldown never starts client-side
SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT unhandled - SPELL_ATTR_COOLDOWN_ON_EVENT abilities never start their parked cooldown timers
SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN unhandled - a server-cleared cooldown stays running in the UI
SMSG_COOLDOWN_CHEAT unhandled - the GM .cooldown wipe is ignored
